question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query with integer casting
WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal as team_goals,
        m.away_team_goal as opponent_goals
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        m.away_team_goal as team_goals,
        m.home_team_goal as opponent_goals
    FROM Match m
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        team_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN team_goals > opponent_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as total_wins
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    t.team_long_name,
    tw.total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON l.id = tw.league_id
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = tw.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, tw.team_api_id ASC) = 1
ORDER BY tw.league_id

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Count wins per team per league
-- A team wins when their goal count > opponent's goal count
-- We need to consider both home and away matches
SELECT 
    m.league_id,
    t.team_api_id,
    t.team_long_name,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
